events.what: Hogan's mapFolding software computes a(19) and a(20) of OEIS A001415 (2 x n stamp foldings)
Hull, Ibrahim, Paltrowitz, Ter-Saakov and Wang give closed forms for stamp foldings with specific fixed mountain-valley assignments, plus bounds for others

judgement.doubts: The bullet is a vague bundle ('various problems'), so 'case' for the MV-restricted count is a judgement; one could read fixed-MV counting as a variant, which would make the status open. DMTCS publication taken from the record (journal page not opened). Direction 'confirmed' is weak: no conjecture was proved, only enumerations obtained.

outcome_prefix: Status rests on Hull, Ibrahim, Paltrowitz, Ter-Saakov and Wang (arXiv:2503.23661, 31 Mar 2025; DMTCS), which settles stamp-folding counts for specific fixed mountain-valley assignments; Hogan's new A001415 terms are finite instances and do not set the status.

corrections.why: F4/F8: two new terms a(19), a(20) of an infinite sequence are finitely many instances, not a settled case; the record's own competing_reading concedes this. The case-level event is the Hull et al. MV-assignment paper.
F8: credited humans must describe the event the status rests on; Hogan's instances are discarded.
F8: sources for the chosen event only.
other: kept, but rests on reading fixed-MV stamp folding as a case of the bullet's vague 'various problems'; if read as a variant the status would be open.
